en.headline: September PMI slips to 49.2 as hiring falls again
en.dek: S&P Global said the seasonally adjusted reading was down from 49.5 in August, a second month below 50, with the sharpest job cuts in nearly six and a half years.
body: S&P Global said on Tuesday that Hong Kong's seasonally adjusted purchasing managers' index fell to 49.2 in September, from 49.5 in August. A reading under 50 points to contraction. It was the second straight month below that line.

Firms told the survey that fewer customers and sharper competition made new orders harder to win. The drop in new orders was slight and narrower than in August. New export orders expanded at the fastest pace since June, the first acceleration in three months, and orders from mainland China rose markedly, according to the release reported by RTHK.

Employment fell for a sixth month, and the pace of the decline was the steepest in nearly six and a half years, with posts left unfilled after staff left. Staff costs were unchanged from August. Fewer workers meant backlogs rose for the first time in three months.

Business confidence weakened for a third month. Firms were more downbeat about the year ahead, citing a difficult economy, competition for scarce orders, and tariff policy. Purchase-price inflation was the smallest in six months, while output prices were still rising, though more slowly, and had now increased for 15 months.

zh.headline: 香港9月PMI降至49.2 就業收縮近六年半最快
zh.dek: 標普全球公布經季節調整指數由8月49.5跌至49.2，連續兩個月低於50，職位收縮速度創近六年半新高。
body: 標普全球星期二公布，香港9月採購經理指數經季節調整後降至49.2，低於8月的49.5。指數低於50表示景氣收縮，這已是連續第二個月處於收縮區間。
受訪企業表示，客戶減少、競爭加劇，爭取新訂單有難度。新增訂單跌幅輕微，而且較8月收窄。港台引述公布說，新出口訂單擴張速度是三個月以來首次加快，並創6月以來最高；來自內地的訂單亦明顯增加。
就業職位連跌六個月，收縮速度創近六年半最高，員工離職後沒有填補。員工成本與8月持平。人手減少令訂單出現積壓，是三個月以來首次。
企業對未來一年的信心連續三個月轉弱，原因包括經濟環境困難、訂單不多引發競爭，以及關稅政策。採購價格升幅是六個月以來最小；產出價格升幅回落，但仍已連續15個月上升。
